scope: One fixed experimental-input setup, four distinct source hypotheses, three one-at-a-time input sensitivities and two data-removal checks for the negative single-trace source case, retained as a conditional working example because it describes the primary data; archive extraction without new minimization.
selection_policy: Charged rho and Kstar mass summaries; evaluated phi electronic width; near-ideal inverse mass root; primary twelve odd summaries. These choices define a conditional comparison, not a uniquely preferred source hypothesis.
conventions: \epsilon^{0123}=+1; metric (+---); canonical c_i=-c_i^R and d_i=-d_i^R; old archives remain reference backend inputs.
uncertainty_policy: Quoted diagonal experimental summaries, fixed central Alda:2026nrd neutral inputs, tree-level real-photon model. Null directions are unmeasured; representatives are not eleven separately measured coefficients. Local prediction errors are sign-branch conditional; no global nonlinear confidence intervals.

results.label: central_universal
results.representative_policy: minimum Euclidean norm in the eleven original coefficients at fitted nuisance values; no coefficient errors inferred
results.local_prediction_uncertainty_scope: conditional on fitted sign branch, fixed central Alda:2026nrd and diagonal summaries; physical observables only; no coefficient or global nonlinear uncertainty
